breathEffect.method: One fixed anatomical mapping per stationary clip; subtle rigid upper pose lift, C1 chest extension and unchanged lower contacts. Independent continuous clock across loops and terminal holds. No per-frame band changes.

name: Entry_Pointing
description: Raise and extend one arm to point right, then hold.
notes: Built-in imagegen whole-character motion stages. Whole-figure scale registration stabilizes character volume. Ground contacts are fixed; genuine airborne run/jump stages retain explicit vertical clearance. Recovery and loop ordering use reviewed source stages. No separated head/body, frame crossfade or optical flow. New drawings require visual review. Scale v6: one fixed whole-character transform per clip, matched to the standing-idle median opaque head silhouette area. It includes eyes/mouth, so blinking does not change the scale estimate. No frame-specific scaling, head/body cuts, or pose-height normalization. Grounded contacts remain y592; flight clearance is transformed about the shared root. Pose projection, breathing and original drawing proportions remain intact.
